description: A fictional rack of three breaching charges game prop for a driller, chunky low-poly, the rack lying flat with its long axis left to right. One thick flat charcoal tray with chamfered edges and solid side walls holding three round cups in a row, short thick square charcoal posts standing around each cup, and one thick raised charcoal end block at each end of the tray. One thick angular charcoal carry handle rises from the two end blocks and runs along the full length of the tray high above the charges, made of straight chamfered segments. In the three cups sit exactly three identical squat ochre painted charge discs, each about 0.20 m across and 0.08 m thick, with wide chamfered edges and a shallow faceted domed top, one big round octagonal dark steel fuse cap at the centre of each dome, one fat raised ochre arrow moulding on each dome on the near side pointing at the fuse cap, and one thick charcoal pad underneath. One small rectangular teal lamp window in a thick raised charcoal bezel in the middle of the tray's near long face.
proportions: About 0.66 m long, 0.22 m wide and 0.30 m tall. (length : width : height = 3.00 : 1 : 1.36)
sides: on the LEFT flank (the near long face, +x) only: the teal lamp window in the middle of the tray's long face, and the three raised arrow mouldings, which sit on the near (left-flank) side of each dome pointing at its fuse cap. The far long face (right flank) is a plain charcoal wall. The three charges, the cups, the posts, the two end blocks and the carry handle are on the centre line.
